content: 1. If an individual’s HIV-positive status has already been confirmed through reliable documentation, such as ELISA, Western blot, or electro-chemiluminescence tests, there is no need to repeat the HIV test. 2. Participants must be male or female and aged 14 years or older. 3. Participants must have one of the following pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) conditions: XDR-TB (Extensively Drug-Resistant TB): A documented positive culture or molecular test for Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) from a sputum sample collected within three months prior to screening or confirmed MTB in sputum based on molecular testing within the same timeframe. Documented resistance to rifamycins, a fluoroquinolone, and an injectable agent during the current TB diagnosis or disease course, either prior to or during the screening period. Sensitivity or resistance to isoniazid may vary. Pre-XDR-TB: A documented positive culture or molecular test for MTB from a sputum sample collected within three months prior to screening or confirmed MTB in sputum based on molecular testing within the same timeframe. Documented resistance to rifamycins and either a fluoroquinolone or an injectable agent during the current TB diagnosis or disease course, either prior to or during the screening period. Sensitivity or resistance to isoniazid may vary. MDR-TB (Multidrug-Resistant TB): A documented positive culture or molecular test for MTB from a sputum sample collected within three months prior to screening or confirmed MTB in sputum based on molecular testing within the same timeframe. Documented resistance to rifamycins during the current TB diagnosis or disease course, either prior to or during the screening period. Sensitivity or resistance to isoniazid may vary. Documented non-response to treatment with the best available regimen for six months or more prior to enrollment, provided the participant has been adherent to treatment and is expected to adhere to the study regimen. Inability to continue second-line drug regimens due to documented intolerance to PAS, ethionamide, aminoglycosides, or fluoroquinolones, or other treatments deemed unsuitable by the investigator. 4. A chest X-ray must be performed within six months prior to or at screening, with results interpreted locally by the investigator or designee. The findings must be consistent with pulmonary TB in the investigator’s opinion. 5. Participants must either be of non-childbearing potential or agree to use effective contraception methods. Non-childbearing potential includes: Not being heterosexually active or practicing sexual abstinence. Females who have undergone bilateral oophorectomy, bilateral tubal ligation, hysterectomy, or are postmenopausal with no menses for at least 12 consecutive months. Males who have undergone vasectomy or bilateral orchiectomy at least three months prior to screening. Effective contraception methods include double-barrier methods (e.g., male condom with diaphragm or cervical cap) or barrier methods combined with hormone-based contraceptives or intrauterine devices. Participants must agree to continue contraception throughout treatment and for six months (females) or 12 weeks (males) after the last dose of study medication. 6. Participants with unstable medical conditions, such as uncontrolled diabetes, cardiomyopathy, or extrapulmonary TB requiring extended treatment, or those with conditions that could compromise their well-being or interfere with protocol assessments, are excluded. 7. Participants with a history of alcohol or drug abuse that could compromise safety or adherence to protocol requirements are excluded. 8. Participants who are not expected to survive for more than six months, as judged by the investigator, are excluded. 9. Participants with a Karnofsky score below 60 at screening are excluded. 10. Participants with a history of allergy or hypersensitivity to any investigational medicinal products or related substances are excluded. 11. Participants with a body mass index (BMI) below 17 kg/m² are excluded. 12. Participants with TB infection and historical drug susceptibility testing (DST) or minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) results suggesting likely resistance to pretomanid, delamanid, linezolid, or bedaquiline must be reviewed by the Sponsor Medical Monitor. 13. Participants expected to require surgical procedures for pulmonary disease are excluded. 14. Participants who have participated in other clinical studies involving investigational agents within eight weeks prior to screening or are currently enrolled in such studies are excluded. However, those in observational studies or follow-up periods of trials without active drug therapy may be considered. 15. Participants with corrected QT interval (QTcF) >500 msec on ECG are excluded. Those with QTcF >450 msec require discussion and approval by the Sponsor Medical Monitor. 16. Participants with a history of heart failure, congenital QT prolongation, untreated hypothyroidism, bradyarrhythmia, or torsades de pointes are excluded. 17. Female participants who are pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to conceive during the study or within six months after treatment cessation, and male participants planning to conceive during the study or within six months after treatment cessation, are excluded. 18. Participants with Grade 3 or 4 peripheral neuropathy, or Grade 1 or 2 neuropathy likely to worsen during the study, are excluded. 19. Participants with prior use of monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) within two weeks of randomization are excluded. 20. Participants with prior use of serotonergic antidepressants within three days of randomization, if there is a potential risk of serotonin syndrome when combined with linezolid, are excluded. 21. Participants who have received more than two weeks of bedaquiline, linezolid, or delamanid prior to the first dose of investigational medicinal product are excluded. 22. Participants with newly diagnosed TB and HIV requiring initiation of HIV therapy before receiving at least two weeks of an antituberculosis regimen are excluded. 23. HIV-infected participants planning continued use of zidovudine, stavudine, or didanosine are excluded. The use of the ART booster cobicistat is also prohibited. 24. Participants with laboratory abnormalities at screening, such as viral load >1000 copies/mL (unless newly diagnosed HIV and not yet on ART), CD4+ count <100 cells/μL, or significant deviations in serum potassium, hemoglobin, platelets, or liver function tests, are excluded. 25. Participants with alanine transaminase (ALT), aspartate transaminase (AST), or bilirubin levels >3 times the upper limit of normal are excluded. 26. Participants with known resistance to bedaquiline, pretomanid, linezolid, or delamanid are excluded. 27. Participants with conditions such as tuberculous meningoencephalitis, brain abscesses, osteomyelitis, or arthritis are excluded. 28. Participants with any other condition, social or medical, that would make study participation unsafe, as judged by the investigator, are excluded.
